function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_delete_release
function.description: Deletes a specified release from the system using its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: The unique identifier of the release to be deleted.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_post_release
function.description: Creates a new release record in the system with the provided details. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

version.description: The version identifier for the release, following Semantic Versioning, such as '1.0.0'.

project_id.description: The unique identifier of the project associated with this release.

description.description: A brief description of the release and its main features.

release_date.description: The release date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

function.name: sli_settings_api_SLISettingsApi_delete_sli_config
function.description: Deletes a Service Level Indicator (SLI) configuration from the system using the specified identifier. This action is irreversible. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

id.description: The unique identifier of the SLI configuration to be deleted.
